column1: # Curated verdicts for the kf literals enum-candidate, flags-candidate and review domains (see enum-domain-plan.md).
# Census domain IDs change between runs; rows are keyed by member slots. Values are census literals before the change.

column7: KF_DISTANCE_NONE; KF_ACTOR_INDEX_NONE; KF_MAP_OBJECT_INDEX_NONE; KF_MAP_EVENT_INDEX_NONE (new); KF_COLLISION_NONE (player distance, before)
column9: every distance helper returns -1 out of reach and every pool search returns -1 with no slot; collision_query_world copies each result into hit, compares it with that sentinel and only then ORs in the KF_COLLISION_* class, so the class sentinel is a separate (linked) value; player_distance_to_point previously spelled KF_COLLISION_NONE
the probe returns collision_query_world's packed result unchanged; both door-update callers now compare it with KF_COLLISION_NONE

every use is guarded by current_floor == KF_FLOOR_4/5 or sits in a floor-5 script/load case: definition 7 is the boss (encounter animations, damage gate, death sequence), 5 transforms into 6 after death on floor 4, and the boss death and a post-defeat floor-5 load end the actors of 0/2/3/4; the slots index the loaded floor's table, so the floor is part of the name and the slot number stays as a WIP suffix

effect kind 9 (actor spawner) spawns definitions 2/4/0 of the loaded floor; the effect comes from actor definition effect codes (resource data), so its floor is not proven and the slots are not given floor names
the three yaw switches and the boss-emitter rotation switch list 0 with the named quarter-turn angles; assignments of angle 0 stay numeric quantities
SAVE_STATUS_OK selects -1, which menu_load_message_image does not treat as its 0xff skip value; the old inline comment moved to the constant

magic.c already passes KF_PLAYER_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER_ONE for spell effects; the constructor stores the byte in KfEffectRecord.id, which every consumer passes as player_apply_damage multiplier_tenths or forwards to a child effect. WARP_SHIMMER_OWNER_ID and the WIP id/effect_owner_id names stay as decided in shared-constant-review.md and naming-review-gameplay.tsv
the default arm (collision-target bits 0) returns 1: not KF_COLLISION_NONE and no class bits (game-magic-collision-literal-ledger.md); the name records only where it occurs
menu_format_number writes value % 10 as the glyph code, so digit glyphs equal their values; zero padding fills with glyph 0 and space padding with MENU_NUMBER_BLANK (10)

fill bytes and sizes, screen coordinates, black back colour and zero sequence volume at SDK/libc boundaries; the formatter's directive and pad characters and the PlayStation save header magic are spelled as the character literals the original used
HP deltas, zero heights and radii, colour levels, depth biases, blends, scales, an angle reset, a countdown reaching zero and initial best distances: magnitudes with named nonzero policies, not codes
dialogue page numbers, the floor-1 tile (7, 40) and two floor-1 world points are authored script positions (game-map-event-literal-ledger.md, game-map-script-literal-ledger.md)
the first level-growth row, pool starts, the highlighted first row, and kana glyph codes written into a label row (encoded text, like string contents)
byte masks over an explicit KF_ENUM_ENCODE view of a word that also counts frames

menu_root returns an item id or a negative KfMenuResult in one word (sign test), shop mode returns an unread 0; save_workspace_allocate's 0/-1 has no caller; effect id 0 is a zero player-damage multiplier
